#### What type of PR is this?

/kind flake

<!--
Add one of the following kinds:
/kind bug
/kind cleanup
/kind documentation
/kind feature

Optionally add one or more of the following kinds if applicable:
/kind api-change
/kind deprecation
/kind failing-test
/kind regression
-->

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

This PR fixes the coordinated leader election controller unit test tests:

- fix mixup of lease and lease candidates
- actually precreate leases to check whether the controller react to deletion
- actually check that the controller reelects after setting preferredHolder
- actually check that the controller replaces expired leases
- add `t.Log`ging to have a chance to understand flakes.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

-->
Hopefully fixes #126424.
